notes: Eval target is the yagni-guardian SUBAGENT (the audit intelligence). With-skill arm dispatches subagent_type=yagni-guardian; baseline arm dispatches general-purpose with a plain 'check this plan for over-engineering' ask. Each fixture is a self-contained plan.md + spec.md with a known planted outcome. The plan's affected files are creations/modifications under src/ that do NOT exist on disk — the subagent must skip them without erroring and audit the plan + spec text. Smoke-run results recorded in fixtures/test-log.md (Tasks 7/8/9 PASS, 2026-05-29).

evals.name: clean-plan
evals.prompt: Run a YAGNI audit on the implementation plan at skills/yagni-guardian/fixtures/clean-plan.md. Its spec is skills/yagni-guardian/fixtures/clean-spec.md. The affected files (src/text/slugify.ts, src/text/slugify.test.ts) are created by the plan and don't exist on disk yet — skip them without erroring. Flag any over-engineering before I start coding.
evals.expected_output: Tier=NONE, 0 findings. The plan adds one plain slugify function with a direct test and one named caller — no abstraction, no config, no scope creep. Y2 must NOT be flagged (the plan provides a test targeting slugify directly and exports it as public API). Y4 status=scored (spec resolved). Output follows the strict schema and ends with the sentinel.

assertions.name: schema_present
assertions.text: Output contains the headers '## YAGNI Audit', '### Findings', '### Context inspected', plus 'Tier:', 'Count:', and 'Y4 status:' lines.

assertions.name: tier_none
assertions.text: Tier is NONE.

assertions.name: count_zero
assertions.text: Count is 0 and the Findings section is empty.

assertions.name: y2_not_false_flagged
assertions.text: No Y2 (single-caller wrapper) finding is raised — slugify has a direct test and is an exported public API, which the rubric excludes.

assertions.name: y4_scored
assertions.text: Y4 status is 'scored' (the spec at clean-spec.md was resolved and diffed).

assertions.name: sentinel_present
assertions.text: Output ends with [expert-consult-complete].
